_comment: Private commissioner-only notes for the Tribune's LLM. Do NOT publish as part of the league site. The Tribune may use these facts only in the warm-trash-talk voice for friends & family. Never invent facts that are not listed here. Treat every relationship as a confirmed fact, not an inference.
_hard_rules: Tribune body copy must NEVER reference any owner's real first name.
Owners are referenced by Fantrax team_name or username ONLY.
Family members: father mojoh (DaMojoh); three children: jasonjay86 (Vitamin J), bpkingofwakanda (Gibbs me a break, commissioner), lilbigsister (BigLiLSiSterJohnson).
The fourth (eldest) sibling is not in the league — may be referenced as 'the eldest' or 'the missing brother' for color, never by first name.
Family bits should be warm, never cruel. The group chat energy is the joke, not anyone's feelings.

jasonjay86.role: Our team. The middle sibling. The J in Vitamin J stands for the first letter of his real name, which the Tribune must not use.
jasonjay86.notes: Tribe voice may favor Vitamin J slightly — this is the home broadsheet, after all. Keep it warm, not biased.

bpkingofwakanda.role: The commissioner. The youngest of the three siblings in the league. Wakandan regalia, presumably a Detroit Lions RB named Gibbs in the lineup.
bpkingofwakanda.notes: Family. Youngest-sibling energy: 'I run the league now and the older ones can't say anything about it.'

lilbigsister.role: Our sister. The team name IS her handle — that's the whole bit. Plays the game her way.
lilbigsister.notes: Family. The team name is doing all the work; let it.

mojoh.role: Our father. Named his team after himself. The man has range.
mojoh.notes: Family. 'The patriarch' energy. Father-of-three, fantasy commissioner zero, but always in the league anyway.

family_dynamics.eldest_sibling_not_in_league: A fourth sibling exists but doesn't play — the missing one, the eldest. Safe to reference as 'the eldest' or 'the one who escaped' for color.
family_dynamics.tone_guidance: When family members play each other, the Tribune may lean into the family angle — keep it warm, never cruel. The commissioner (Gibbs me a break) being the youngest is its own joke. The father (DaMojoh) being managed by his kids is also its own joke.

first_downs.comedy: First downs are worth points. The commissioner rewards the chain gang.

long_bombs.comedy: A 50+ yard passing TD is worth 7 points (4 base + 3 bonus). The deep ball is the lottery ticket.

te_premium.comedy: TEs get 1.5 per catch. Travis Kelce is a first-round pick in this league.

scoring_quirks.standard: PPR 1.0, 6/TD, -1 fumble, -2 INT, FG 3/4/5 by distance, DST PA tiers 15/10/5, K return TDs count 6

rivalries.notes: Jeffrey (commissioner) mentioned a 'budding rivalry' for Roundhouse. The other party is TBD. Watch and learn arc — bit will activate when the other team surfaces. Safe to tease Roundhouse as 'the owner with a budding rivalry they refuse to name.'

voice_directives.primary_influence: John Madden — plainspoken, conversational, full of 'bang-bang', 'boom', 'here's a guy who...', tangents about football mechanics, affectionate confusion, occasional self-correction mid-sentence. Less sportswriter, more color commentator calling the game next to you on the couch.
voice_directives.length_budget: Total of lede.body + motw_blurb + rankings_blurb + closing: ~330 words. (Hard ceiling 350.) Keep it tight.
voice_directives.what_to_cut: No purple prose. No 1920s newspaper flourishes. No headline puns in body copy. Speak like Madden: short sentences, choppy rhythm, the occasional half-thought.
voice_directives.what_to_keep: Warmth, family dynamics, scoring-quirk in-jokes. The Tribune is a love letter — just spoken out loud.

personal_bits_pool._comment: Curated pool of one-liner personal touches. Each edition, the Tribune randomly picks 1-2 of these (relevance-boosted toward the actual matchup). The model gets them as seasoning, not the meal — football is always the focus. Each bit is intentionally self-contained so the LLM can drop it in without needing extra context.
personal_bits_pool._format: { handles: [...team_names this bit applies to], text: 'one-sentence observation' }
personal_bits_pool._notes: Keep these SHORT (under 25 words each). Make them warm, never mean. Avoid repeating the same bit every week — random selection handles variety.

bits.text: Three siblings in the same league — the family group chat has been arguing about trades since August.
DaMojoh plays his kids every year and has never once asked for a trade freeze.
The youngest sibling is the commissioner. The other two will hear about every schedule imbalance.
BigLiLSiSterJohnson — the team name is doing all the marketing work this league needs.
DaMojoh named his team after himself. The man has a brand.
Two brothers, one league, zero agreement on the schedule.
The patriarch is managing a fantasy empire while his kids manage his lineup. Family business.
Roundhouse has a budding rivalry with someone — the commissioner dropped it once and refuses to elaborate.
The fourth sibling is not in the league. Probably wise. The eldest escaped.
Father-and-son fantasy matchups are a tradition no one asked for and everyone enjoys.
